verses.arabic: حمٓ
verses.english: Ha, Meem.
verses.transliteration_html: <u>Ha</u>meem
verses.transliteration_text: Hameem

verses.arabic: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.english: By the Manifest Book!
verses.transliteration_html: Waalkitabi almubeeni
verses.transliteration_text: Waalkitabi almubeeni

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
verses.english: We sent it down on a blessed night, and We have been warning [mankind].
verses.transliteration_html: Inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireena

verses.arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
verses.english: Every definitive matter is resolved on it,
verses.transliteration_html: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeemin
verses.transliteration_text: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeemin

verses.arabic: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
verses.english: as an ordinance from Us. We have been sending [apostles]
verses.transliteration_html: Amran min AAindina inna kunna mursileena
verses.transliteration_text: Amran min AAindina inna kunna mursileena

verses.arabic: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.english: as a mercy from your Lord—indeed He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing—
verses.transliteration_html: Rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu
verses.transliteration_text: Rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

verses.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.english: the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatever is between them, should you have conviction.
verses.transliteration_html: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena
verses.transliteration_text: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena

verses.arabic: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.english: There is no god except Him: He gives life and brings death, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.
verses.transliteration_html: La ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena
verses.transliteration_text: La ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena

verses.arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.english: But they play around in doubt.
verses.transliteration_html: Bal hum fee shakkin yalAAaboona
verses.transliteration_text: Bal hum fee shakkin yalAAaboona

verses.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.english: So watch out for the day when the sky brings on a manifest smoke,
verses.transliteration_html: Fairtaqib yawma tatee alssamao bidukhanin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Fairtaqib yawma tatee alssamao bidukhanin mubeenin

verses.arabic: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
verses.english: enveloping the people. [They will cry out:] ‘This is a painful punishment.
verses.transliteration_html: Yaghsha alnnasa hatha AAathabun aleemun
verses.transliteration_text: Yaghsha alnnasa hatha AAathabun aleemun

verses.arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: Our Lord! Remove this punishment from us. Indeed we have believed!’
verses.transliteration_html: Rabbana ikshif AAanna alAAathaba inna muminoona
verses.transliteration_text: Rabbana ikshif AAanna alAAathaba inna muminoona

verses.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verses.english: What will the admonition avail them, when a manifest apostle had already come to them,
verses.transliteration_html: Anna lahumu alththikra waqad jaahum rasoolun mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Anna lahumu alththikra waqad jaahum rasoolun mubeenun

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ
verses.english: but they turned away from him, and said, ‘A tutored madman?’
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma tawallaw AAanhu waqaloo muAAallamun majnoonun
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma tawallaw AAanhu waqaloo muAAallamun majnoonun

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
verses.english: Indeed We will withdraw the punishment a little; but you will revert [to your earlier ways].
verses.transliteration_html: Inna kashifoo alAAathabi qaleelan innakum AAaidoona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna kashifoo alAAathabi qaleelan innakum AAaidoona

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
verses.english: The day We shall strike with the most terrible striking, We will indeed take vengeance [on them].
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma nabtishu albatshata alkubra inna muntaqimoona
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma nabtishu albatshata alkubra inna muntaqimoona

verses.arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
verses.english: Certainly We tried the people of Pharaoh before them, when a noble apostle came to them,
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma firAAawna wajaahum rasoolun kareemun
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma firAAawna wajaahum rasoolun kareemun

verses.arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
verses.english: [saying,] ‘Give over the servants of Allah to me; indeed I am a trusted apostle [sent] to you.
verses.transliteration_html: An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun
verses.transliteration_text: An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

verses.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
verses.english: Do not defy Allah. Indeed I bring you a manifest authority.
verses.transliteration_html: Waan la taAAloo AAala Allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Waan la taAAloo AAala Allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeenin

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
verses.english: I seek the protection of my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainnee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum an tarjumooni
verses.transliteration_text: Wainnee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum an tarjumooni

verses.arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
verses.english: And if you do not believe me, keep out of my way.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wain lam tuminoo lee faiAAtazilooni
verses.transliteration_text: Wain lam tuminoo lee faiAAtazilooni

verses.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ
verses.english: Then he invoked his Lord, [saying,] ‘These are indeed a guilty lot.’
verses.transliteration_html: FadaAAa rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoona
verses.transliteration_text: FadaAAa rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoona

verses.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.english: [Allah told him,] ‘Set out by night with My servants; for you will be pursued.
verses.transliteration_html: Faasri biAAibadee laylan innakum muttabaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Faasri biAAibadee laylan innakum muttabaAAoona

verses.arabic: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.english: Leave behind the sea unmoving; for they will be a drowned host.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waotruki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waotruki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoona

verses.arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
verses.english: How many gardens and springs did they leave behind!
verses.transliteration_html: Kam tarakoo min jannatin waAAuyoonin
verses.transliteration_text: Kam tarakoo min jannatin waAAuyoonin

verses.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
verses.english: Fields and splendid places,
verses.transliteration_html: WazurooAAin wamaqamin kareemin
verses.transliteration_text: WazurooAAin wamaqamin kareemin

verses.arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
verses.english: and the affluence wherein they rejoiced!
verses.transliteration_html: WanaAAmatin kanoo feeha fakiheena
verses.transliteration_text: WanaAAmatin kanoo feeha fakiheena

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.english: So it was; and We bequeathed them to another people.
verses.transliteration_html: Kathalika waawrathnaha qawman akhareena
verses.transliteration_text: Kathalika waawrathnaha qawman akhareena

verses.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
verses.english: So neither the sky wept for them, nor the earth; nor were they granted any respite.
verses.transliteration_html: Fama bakat AAalayhimu alssamao waalardu wama kanoo munthareena
verses.transliteration_text: Fama bakat AAalayhimu alssamao waalardu wama kanoo munthareena

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
verses.english: Certainly We delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina alAAathabi almuheeni
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina alAAathabi almuheeni

verses.arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.english: of Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a tyrant among the transgressors.
verses.transliteration_html: Min firAAawna innahu kana AAaliyan mina almusrifeena
verses.transliteration_text: Min firAAawna innahu kana AAaliyan mina almusrifeena

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.english: Certainly We chose them knowingly above all the nations,
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqadi ikhtarnahum AAala AAilmin AAala alAAalameena
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqadi ikhtarnahum AAala AAilmin AAala alAAalameena

verses.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ
verses.english: and We gave them some signs in which there was a manifest test.
verses.transliteration_html: Waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeenun
verses.transliteration_text: Waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeenun

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.english: These ones say,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna haolai layaqooloona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna haolai layaqooloona

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
verses.english: ‘It will be only our first death, and we shall not be resurrected.
verses.transliteration_html: In hiya illa mawtatuna aloola wama nahnu bimunshareena
verses.transliteration_text: In hiya illa mawtatuna aloola wama nahnu bimunshareena

verses.arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.english: Bring our fathers back [to life], if you are truthful.’
verses.transliteration_html: Fatoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Fatoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena

verses.arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
verses.english: Are they better, or the people of Tubba‘, and those who were before them? We destroyed them; indeed, they were guilty.
verses.transliteration_html: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaAAin waallatheena min qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaAAin waallatheena min qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeena

verses.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
verses.english: We did not create the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them for play.
verses.transliteration_html: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena
verses.transliteration_text: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena

verses.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: We did not create them except with consummate wisdom; but most of them do not know.
verses.transliteration_html: Ma khalaqnahuma illa bialhaqqi walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ma khalaqnahuma illa bialhaqqi walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.english: Indeed the Day of Judgement is the tryst for them all,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna yawma alfasli meeqatuhum ajmaAAeena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna yawma alfasli meeqatuhum ajmaAAeena

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.english: the day when a friend will not avail a friend in any way, nor will they be helped,
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma la yughnee mawlan AAan mawlan shayan wala hum yunsaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma la yughnee mawlan AAan mawlan shayan wala hum yunsaroona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.english: except for him on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed He is the All-mighty, the All-merciful.
verses.transliteration_html: Illa man rahima Allahu innahu huwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu
verses.transliteration_text: Illa man rahima Allahu innahu huwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

verses.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
verses.english: Indeed the tree of Zaqqum
verses.transliteration_html: Inna shajarata alzzaqqoomi
verses.transliteration_text: Inna shajarata alzzaqqoomi

verses.arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
verses.english: will be the food of the sinful.
verses.transliteration_html: TaAAamu alatheemi
verses.transliteration_text: TaAAamu alatheemi

verses.arabic: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
verses.english: Like molten copper it will boil in their bellies,
verses.transliteration_html: Kaalmuhli yaghlee fee albutooni
verses.transliteration_text: Kaalmuhli yaghlee fee albutooni

verses.arabic: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.english: seething like boiling water.
verses.transliteration_html: Kaghalyi alhameemi
verses.transliteration_text: Kaghalyi alhameemi

verses.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.english: [The keepers of hell will be told,] ‘Seize him and drag him to the middle of hell,
verses.transliteration_html: Khuthoohu faiAAtiloohu ila sawai aljaheemi
verses.transliteration_text: Khuthoohu faiAAtiloohu ila sawai aljaheemi

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.english: then pour over his head boiling water as punishment,
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma subboo fawqa rasihi min AAathabi alhameemi
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma subboo fawqa rasihi min AAathabi alhameemi

verses.arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
verses.english: [and tell them,] “Taste this! Indeed you are the [self-styled] mighty and noble!
verses.transliteration_html: Thuq innaka anta alAAazeezu alkareemu
verses.transliteration_text: Thuq innaka anta alAAazeezu alkareemu

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
verses.english: This is what you used to doubt!’
verses.transliteration_html: Inna hatha ma kuntum bihi tamtaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna hatha ma kuntum bihi tamtaroona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ
verses.english: Indeed the Godwary will be in a safe place,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna almuttaqeena fee maqamin ameenin
verses.transliteration_text: Inna almuttaqeena fee maqamin ameenin

verses.arabic: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
verses.english: amid gardens and springs,
verses.transliteration_html: Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin
verses.transliteration_text: Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

verses.arabic: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
verses.english: dressed in fine silk and brocade, sitting face to face.
verses.transliteration_html: Yalbasoona min sundusin waistabraqin mutaqabileena
verses.transliteration_text: Yalbasoona min sundusin waistabraqin mutaqabileena

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
verses.english: So shall it be, and We shall wed them to black-eyed houris.
verses.transliteration_html: Kathalika wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Kathalika wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin

verses.arabic: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.english: Secure [from any kind of harm,] there they will call for every kind of fruit [they wish].
verses.transliteration_html: YadAAoona feeha bikulli fakihatin amineena
verses.transliteration_text: YadAAoona feeha bikulli fakihatin amineena

verses.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.english: Other than the first death, they will not taste death therein, and He will save them from the punishment of hell
verses.transliteration_html: La yathooqoona feeha almawta illa almawtata aloola wawaqahum AAathaba aljaheemi
verses.transliteration_text: La yathooqoona feeha almawta illa almawtata aloola wawaqahum AAathaba aljaheemi

verses.arabic: فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.english: —a grace from your Lord. That is the great success.
verses.transliteration_html: Fadlan min rabbika thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu
verses.transliteration_text: Fadlan min rabbika thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu

verses.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.english: Indeed We have made it simple in your language, so that they may take admonition.
verses.transliteration_html: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika laAAallahum yatathakkaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

verses.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
verses.english: So wait! They [too] are waiting.
verses.transliteration_html: Fairtaqib innahum murtaqiboona
verses.transliteration_text: Fairtaqib innahum murtaqiboona
